prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL transparent pixel-art game effect, Shadow Break for a hooded shadow boxer. The supplied image is STYLE/PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY; do not copy its labels or layout. Create a square 2-by-2 sheet with FOUR distinct consecutive animation drawings in equal cells, each centred on the same impact landmark, large transparent gaps. At game size each drawing fits a 64x64 pixel canvas; render chunky clear pixel clusters for nearest-neighbour extraction. Phase order reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom: (1) four broken violet crescents implode toward a compact dark centre, (2) a compressed black-violet core with an ivory crack, (3) a jagged violet/ivory SHATTER star and dark angular fragments explode outward, (4) a few dissipating violet fragments and broken arcs. It must read as stored shadow pressure being spent, not a fist punch or haymaker. Silhouette and contrast change dramatically by phase. Charcoal black, indigo, lilac, sparse warm ivory. Hard pixel edges, restrained shading, no soft glow, no opaque backplate, no ground crater, no full-screen flash, no text, no body or extra objects. Genuine transparent background, four equal cells, one effect per cell, no drawings crossing cells.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL transparent pixel-art personal buff aura for a shadow boxer, low-key full-Rhythm state. Supplied image is STYLE/PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY. Create a square 2-by-2 sheet of FOUR consecutive pulse phases in equal cells, identical centre and footprint, separated on true transparent alpha. This is a small personal aura around a champion's FEET, not an attack area or dangerous ground zone. Each phase is a thin broken elliptical violet ribbon lying under his boots, with two or three short wisps rising near the sides, an unobstructed centre, no body. Use charcoal-violet, clear lilac edge pixels and tiny ivory accents. Phase 1 tightening broken ellipse, phase 2 gently lifted short wisps, phase 3 a restrained brighter pulse, phase 4 wisps settle back into the first outline. Keep the footprint and wisp scale consistent, readable on both light and dark terrain. It should work beneath a normal dark-purple boxer or his darker fused-shadow body without hiding his legs or face. Logical game canvas 64x64 with the aura ellipse near y=50 (ground contact); draw chunky pixel clusters, hard edges, minimal shading, NO blur or soft bloom. Four isolated drawings, no labels, no numbers, no border, no ground plate, no other objects, genuine transparent background.
